name: pdf2md
description: Convert PDF to Markdown with OCR using the pdf2md container

input_file.description: Path to the input PDF file (relative to workspace or absolute)

output_file.description: Path for the output Markdown file (optional, defaults to input filename with .md extension)

automation.prompt: Run the pdf2md container to convert the PDF file to markdown with OCR. Input: {{input_file}}. Output: {{output_file}}. Use docker run --rm -v ${workspaceFolder}:/data pdf2md:latest {{input_file}} [-o {{output_file}}].
